title: ZILFIT Emotion Pipeline Result
description: Engineering-only pipeline output for session persistence. No medical, diagnostic, therapeutic, or treatment claims.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the session was created.

emotional_target.description: Primary emotional/comfort target for the edition (e.g. grounding, release, alertness, stability, soothing).

density_map.description: Per-zone density values for heel, midfoot, forefoot, and toe.

pressure_zones.description: List of active pressure zone identifiers from solar_plexus_map.

geometry_hints.description: Zone geometry hints for Z-CAD (shape, depth, diameter, height, cad_direction).

cad_directives.description: Engineering directives for Z-CAD geometry generation (stimulation type, coverage, intensity).

simulation_profile.description: Stimulation profile: type, frequency_hz, intensity, coverage_percent, description.

warnings.description: Engineering validation warnings. Empty list if none.

raw_payload_json.description: Full raw pipeline result serialized as a JSON string for audit/comparison.
